lesson.detail: Vitest no longer searches parent directories for config files; if running vitest from a subdirectory, pass the config explicitly.

test.error: FAIL: running vitest from a subdirectory used the vitest.config of the parent directory

source.quote: Vitest no longer searches parent directories for config files. If you previously relied on running vitest from a subdirectory while using a config file from a parent directory, pass the config explicitly
